verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI markets natural-language debugging and large-codebase navigation (gemini-cli-gh-3, gh-1, gh-12) and one HN user praises its ability to navigate huge codebases (comm-1), but multiple hands-on reports directly contradict the debugging/root-cause claim — users describe it getting stuck in error loops, rewriting files, jumping straight into 'spaghetti code' without a plan mode, and being '10x slower' at codebase navigation than alternatives (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15). There's no dedicated evidence of a verify-fix workflow or reproduction tooling beyond generic debugging claims. Missing for 10: concrete reproduce-issue workflow, fix-verification evidence, and resolution of the conflicting hands-on reports.
